clock_semantics.rq3_alerts: replayed on the episode's synthetic clock: each persisted snapshot is re-analysed with generated_at=point.timestamp and fed to AlertService.sync_from_snapshot in timestamp order
clock_semantics.rq3_recovery: two sessions on one vehicle: fault session (synthetic clock T) then a condition-free normal session (clock T + 1 day) so the two never overlap
clock_semantics.rq4_latency: separate wall-clock streaming run (generated_at=None); ingest latency is publish_ts -> persisted created_at using a monotonic clock, so it is host-local and excludes any external network hop
clock_semantics.rq6_robustness: wall-clock injection against the live subscriber; injected faults and the resulting persisted row counts are measured, not simulated
